Calcium (+2) constant-field flux and reversal; independent scalar stage derivative with exactly one cytosol/extracellular owner and physical energy derivative
Strict calcium channel identities, membrane/species binding, gate domains, nonnegative capacities, control boundaries and combined inventory/gate loss bounds
Independent DOP853 and Radau full-state trajectories, mutual agreement and 25/12.5/6.25 us refinement at unchanged tolerances
Blocked, zero-permeability and zero-abundance channels reduce all prior state exactly to spatial_calcium@2 while gates keep relaxing; merged calcium/plasma/ER timed interventions
Complete scalar/batch snapshots, window restart, world partitions 1/2/3 and future calcium controls; corrupt gate, transfer, energy, padding and interior cubic rejection
Assembly event-union independent reference, complete restart and world partitions; channel-dependent calcium response with unchanged protein streams
Ensemble model and random-world identity preserved through four nodes/16 GPUs; complete saved CPU/L4 state agreement
Full prior plasma, spatial calcium, ER, chemistry, reaction and checkpoint panel plus selected assembly-cluster regressions
resource_rationale: Fresh CPU and L4 runs of the new channel panel plus all prior 233 checks. The earlier plasma CPU+GPU panel used about 66 minutes and nearly 8 GiB RSS; allow three hours and 12 GiB RSS for the added compiled family. A 1 GiB artifact/cache allowance fits current disk space while preserving 4 GiB free. No scientific tolerances relaxed.
scope_exclusions: Native BETSE initialization lifecycle, complete trajectories or equivalence to its semi-implicit time updater
Biological calibration, measured channel abundance/permeability, temperature compensation, calcium-dependent channel inactivation or gating charge/energy
Calcium-driven assembly or protein chemistry consuming ions or ATP; direct assembly control of the new calcium channels
Detailed two-calcium SERCA, proton countertransport, finite ATP, IP3, variable volume, mechanics or lifecycle
Cross-region junctions, sustained utilization/speedup, distributed single-world integration or actual JUPITER execution
